about: P1 R1 form library: the upper torso's span (OURS, designed; rule "field"). Replaces MakeHuman's measure-shoulder-dist target, which is a pure sideways move of everything past the shoulder (8.1 mm at 0.3, ramped over 11-17 cm out).

shoulder_span.why: the shoulders' span: the shoulder and the whole arm move out 27 mm a side at v = 1 (her 0.3: 8.1 mm), the chest and trapezius between 10.5 and 17.5 cm out stretch to meet them (C2); the arm below 1.25 m (the A-pose rest's elbows and hands) moves whole by the second move (the two y windows sum to 1), the hips (under 25 cm out) never move
